description.value: Khaghan is a modern Persian restaurant in North Vancouver serving fire-grilled meats, saffron-laced stews, and traditional Iranian rice dishes made with halal-certified meats and imported ingredients. The multi-level venue seats over 200 guests across two floors and a patio, and comes alive on weekends with live music and dancing. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a substantial, flavour-forward meal with genuine dietary breadth — vegan, vegetarian, dairy-free, and gluten-free options are woven throughout the menu.

address.value: 935 Marine Dr Unit 66, North Vancouver, BC V7P 1S3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms an active, modern Persian restaurant at 935 Marine Dr Unit 66, North Vancouver. Menu pages confirm explicit vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options throughout, and the site prominently features online ordering (takeout). No mention of bike parking, racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site.
